The '''HN-TR Assassin/Combat Droid Prototype''' was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. The manufacturer of the prototype was unknown and it was believed that the only surviving model, [[HN-TR1]], killed the design team upon activation and then destroyed the schematics to ensure HN-TR1 would be the only model of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in existence.<ref name="AIR" />
